recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented skill set command with all acceptance criteria:

- ac-1: --description option updates description field in meta
- ac-2: --add-platform adds platform to platforms array (no duplicates)
- ac-3: --add-tag adds tag to tags array (no duplicates)

Additional features beyond AC requirements:
- --name, --origin, --skill-version for updating other fields
- --remove-platform, --remove-tag for removing items from arrays
- --add-depends-on, --remove-depends-on for managing dependencies
- Schema validation on save
- ULID prefix lookup support

Added 19 tests specific to skill set command covering all ACs.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented --content-file option for skill add command:

- ac-1: Meta entry created in manifest skills array (existing behavior)
- ac-2: Auto-committed to shadow branch via commitIfShadow (existing behavior)
- ac-3: Added --content-file option - reads file and copies contents to .kspec/skills/<id>/SKILL.md
- ac-4: Origin set correctly (existing behavior)
- ac-5: Version set correctly (existing behavior)
- ac-6: Duplicate ID error (existing behavior)

Added 4 tests specific to @skill-add spec:
- should copy content from --content-file to SKILL.md
- should handle relative path for --content-file
- should error when --content-file does not exist
- should set origin and version when --origin core --skill-version provided

Note: daemon-executable.test.ts has a pre-existing failure unrelated to this change.

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented Skill CLI Commands:

- ac-1: kspec skill list displays table with ID, Name, Origin, Version, Platforms columns
- ac-2: kspec skill list --json returns JSON array with full skill metadata
- ac-3: kspec skill add creates meta entry with origin (default: project)
- ac-4: kspec skill add creates .kspec/skills/<id>/SKILL.md file
- ac-5: kspec skill get displays metadata including id, name, origin, platforms
- ac-6: kspec skill get displays SKILL.md content
- ac-7: kspec skill delete --confirm removes meta entry from manifest
- ac-8: kspec skill delete removes .kspec/skills/<id>/ directory

Also:
- Changed --version to --skill-version to avoid conflict with CLI global --version flag
- Added origin/tag filtering for skill list
- Added dependency checking for skill delete (prevents deletion if other skills depend on it)

29 tests covering all 8 ACs in tests/skill-cli.test.ts

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented Skill Validation:

- ac-1: Missing content file validation already existed (from skill-content-model), verified working
- ac-2: Added validateSkillDependsOn() - validates depends_on refs resolve and point to skills
- ac-3: Added findOrphanedSkillDirectories() - detects skill directories without meta entries
- ac-4: Added skills loop in validateMetaManifestFile() matching agents/workflows/conventions pattern

Also:
- Added skills to allMetaItems for reference indexing
- Added skills count to metaStats

14 tests covering all 4 ACs in tests/skill-validation.test.ts

recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Implemented Skill Parser Integration:

- ac-1: saveMetaItem now supports 'skill' type, appends to manifest.skills and writes to disk
- ac-2: When saving a skill, creates .kspec/skills/<id>/ directory
- ac-3: deleteMetaItem now supports 'skill' type, removes from manifest.skills
- ac-4: When deleting a skill, removes .kspec/skills/<id>/ directory recursively
- ac-5: getMetaStats already included skills count (verified via tests)
- ac-6: isMetaItemType already returns true for 'skill' (verified via tests)

14 tests covering all 6 ACs in tests/skill-parser-integration.test.ts

recently_completed.title: Implement ralph wrap-up agent on loop exit
recently_completed.closed_reason: Merged in PR #369. inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.
